findings.title: 9421 connect requires LoadStart after Frida ready
findings.claim: Frida cdp_filter_attached and load_start_attached do not make WMPF own 127.0.0.1:9421. loadStartEntered stays 0 unless the mini-program is closed and reopened after inject.

evidence.observation: hookAttach passed; runtimeBridge failed; frida.message=6; loadStartEntered=0 for 120s
ready at 08:44:33.676Z; attach_result connected=false at 08:45:33.691Z; wait_result connected=false at 08:46:33.710Z
post-inject close+reopen: runtimeBridge passed, frida.message=893, runtime.connected=3

findings.impact: Unattended attach still has one irreducible human lifecycle step. Live full-semantic cannot start without it.
findings.recommendation: Keep the coordinated choreography: inject first, then close+reopen. Do not treat hook ready as bridge connected.

findings.title: forceDebugTrigger is observation-only
findings.claim: Hook RPC forceDebugTrigger reports counters but does not call the native CDP filter. attemptedNativeCall remains false.

evidence.observation: NativeFunction calls are opt-in and must not crash WeChat
force_debug_trigger mode=observation attemptedNativeCall=false cdpFilterEntered=0 loadStartEntered=0 calls=1 then 2

findings.impact: Product cannot auto-trigger 9421. Calling this a completed unattended attach is false.
findings.recommendation: Leave the stub as observation. Any native call requires an explicit, crash-safe experiment and must not be the default live-gate path.

findings.title: Connected 9421 session had zero WMPF AppService contexts
findings.claim: After runtimeBridge pass, wxmp_probe_contexts returned no contexts. session.contexts is filled only from addJsContext; this capture had no context.added events.

evidence.observation: execution_added=4 execution_removed=4 scriptParsed=174 requestWillBeSent=46 setupContext=3; no context.added; contexts=[] at export
handleContext add only from decoded addJsContext; probeContexts iterates session.contexts

findings.impact: evaluate/breakpoint/trace/hooks cannot run. Full-semantic remains runtime-pending even when CDP is live.
findings.recommendation: On resume, keep probing after reconnect. If contexts stay empty, inspect setupContext artifacts clean-room; do not copy GPL decoders.

findings.title: Live-gate AppService loop lost reconnect churn
findings.claim: Committed runner defaulted contextTimeoutMs to 20s and used call(wxmp_probe_contexts), which throws RUNTIME_NOT_CONNECTED when the socket is down.

evidence.observation: committed default context-timeout-ms 20000; call() is fatal on tool error
probeContexts throws RUNTIME_NOT_CONNECTED if bridge is not connected
runtime.connected=3 runtime.disconnected=2 during the AppService window

findings.impact: A connected-then-churned runtime looks like 'no AppService' even if a later generation would register contexts.
findings.recommendation: Keep the working-tree 60s wait, wait_for_runtime retry, and active-only selection; commit before the next live attempt.

findings.title: setupContext may be the 20079 context registration face
findings.claim: The connected session recorded three unknown setupContext envelopes and zero addJsContext events. That is not proof that setupContext replaces addJsContext.

evidence.observation: known categories: chromeDevtools, chromeDevtoolsResult, addJsContext, removeJsContext

findings.impact: A 60s retry alone may still miss AppService if 20079 never sends addJsContext.
findings.recommendation: Clean-room inspect bounded protocol artifacts after the next connect. Do not import GPL generated protobuf.

findings.title: Unknown WMPF categories are retained as artifacts
findings.claim: customMessage, domEvent, and setupContext payloads were hashed and written under the session protocol directory instead of being dropped.

evidence.observation: three open unknown-protocol findings with SHA-256 and evidenceTypes

findings.impact: Protocol learning can continue from workspace artifacts without claiming decoders exist.
findings.recommendation: Keep bounded recorder. Promote a category to the known registry only after clean-room attestation.
